messages:
Ana (partnerships): Quick sync — we need a partner-facing plan for the SDK/response-envelope rename that hits marketplace listings, HW integrators, and SIs. I propose a staggered 6-week roll with per-partner grace windows.
Sam H (eng): +1. Can we map partners to tiers so we know who gets extended windows?
Jordan L (product): Tiering: Tier A = active integrations & marketplace featured sellers (2-week grace), Tier B = certified SIs (4-week), Tier C = community/long-tail (6-week).
Leila M (solutions): For SIs we should run a dry-run: give them the flagged SDK and a staged rollout so they can test in their staging tenants. Who owns the dry-run invites?
Mike R (partner-eng): I can own invites for the top 8 SIs. Will coordinate with their PMs — need email templates and FAQ.
Ana (partnerships): Perfect — Leila: can you draft dry-run acceptance criteria? Also want a short migration checklist we can add to marketplace docs.
Leila M (solutions): Draft checklist: 1) run smoke on auth flow, 2) validate response schema, 3) verify long-poll streaming, 4) run sample inference at scale. Will post PR tomorrow.
Sam H (eng): On the runtime side we'll gate the rename behind a feature flag per-tenant and provide a compatibility shim for 8 weeks. Shim example:
```bash
# quick migration shim (example)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/migrate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"old_field":"..."}'
```
Jordan L (product): Marketplace Bot — can we surface a banner start/end window per partner listing? We should avoid global blackout.
Marketplace Bot: banner scheduled. Use /marketplace banner create --listing <id> --start 2026-05-10 --end 2026-06-21 --message "SDK migration window: check your integration"
Mike R (partner-eng): Communication plan draft: Week 0: partner heads-up + FAQ. Week 2: dry-run invites (SIs). Week 4: marketplace soft banner. Week 6: public deprecation announcement + final sunset timer.
Ana (partnerships): Approvals needed: legal sign-off on comms, security sign-off on shim guarantees, and a PSR (partner support readiness) doc. Who's doing legal?
Jordan L (product): I'll ping Legal (cc: @legal-team) and get a one-pager.
Sam H (eng): Ops Bot — can you reserve rollback windows (2 hours) for each major partner deploy and create an incident playbook template we can attach?
Ops Bot: Rollback windows reserved. Playbook template: /playbooks/sdk-rename-rollback.md attached to the thread.
Leila M (solutions): One more ask: provide a small test harness (docker) SIs can run locally to validate. I can ship that next week.
Mike R (partner-eng): I'll compile partner-specific timelines in a spreadsheet and share by EOD Friday.
Ana (partnerships): Great — action items recap: Sam: feature-flag + shim + rollback playbook. Leila: dry-run criteria + test harness. Mike: partner timelines & comms. Jordan: legal + marketplace banner cadence. I'll own the overall partner comms and FAQ.
Jordan L (product): Also consider embedding a simple compatibility header in responses for the transition: `X-Redwood-SDK-Version: 2026-rename-v1`. Helps partners detect.
Sam H (eng): Good idea — we'll add header and include it in telemetry so we can triage who hasn't migrated.
Ana (partnerships): Thanks all. We'll meet Thurs 9am PT to lock down the final dates. :calendar:
Mike R (partner-eng): ACK.
Leila M (solutions): ACK.
Jordan L (product): ACK.
Sam H (eng): ACK.
Marketplace Bot: Reminder scheduled: meeting Thu 9am PT.
Ops Bot: Thread pinned in #partnerships for visibility.
